acceptance_language_rule: IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, VERIFIED and ACCEPTED are not synonyms. Only independent verification (P17-J) may use ACCEPTED. Cline-authored verification is IMPLEMENTED/TESTED, never independent verification.

status_conditional_acceptance_rule.statement: The acceptance level required of a category or feature is a function of its authoritative architecture status, NOT of the phase gate that happens to contain it. P17-E, P17-F and P17-G apply this one rule; no gate redefines it. NO gate may demand implementation E2E verification of a category whose status is NOT_IMPLEMENTED or DEFERRED.

SUPPORTED.rule: the full defined acceptance path must pass (END-TO-END VERIFIED)
SUPPORTED.report_must_contain: the E2E result for that category

PARTIAL.rule: only the explicitly bounded/in-scope acceptance path must pass; this is bounded acceptance and is NOT a full E2E claim
PARTIAL.report_must_contain: the bounded in-scope result AND an explicit statement of what remains outside scope

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.rule: no implementation E2E is required; the feature/category must be explicitly recorded as not implemented
NOT_IMPLEMENTED.report_must_contain: an explicit blocked/not-implemented record naming the missing prerequisite (e.g. methodology, input contract or processor declaration)

DEFERRED.rule: no implementation E2E is required; the deferral and its dependency must be explicit
DEFERRED.report_must_contain: an explicit deferral record naming the PO decision or prerequisite that blocks it

status_conditional_acceptance_rule.non_upgrade_clause: PARTIAL is NOT upgraded to SUPPORTED by this rule and no category status is changed by it. A PARTIAL category is never required to produce a full E2E claim, and a NOT_IMPLEMENTED or DEFERRED category is never required to produce any implementation E2E result.
forbidden: requiring an E2E implementation result for a NOT_IMPLEMENTED or DEFERRED category
treating a documented blocked/deferred outcome as a gate failure
treating a documented blocked/deferred outcome as delivery of the category
redefining the status vocabulary inside an individual phase gate
status_conditional_acceptance_rule.historical_note: Before ARCH-06, P17-E bullet 1 was status-conditional while P17-F bullet 1 read 'one END-TO-END VERIFIED result per category (6,7,8,9,10) where the category is not DEFERRED' and P17-G bullet 1 read the same for (11,12,13,14,15). Because category 10 is NOT_IMPLEMENTED (not DEFERRED), P17-F bullet 1 still demanded an E2E result for a non-implemented category - the same contradiction class ARCH-03 raised against P17-E. Independently identified by ARCH-05 as ARCH05-01 (and ARCH05-03 for the PARTIAL bucket), corrected by ARCH-06.
